title: Juicy Earthy Dutch Potato Stir-fry
description: This light Dutch dish features juicy potatoes and earthy flavors enhanced with horseradish for a unique twist. Halal-friendly and perfect as a side or main course.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: kosher or regular salt, halal if needed

ingredients.name: baking soda
ingredients.notes: for a slight starchiness without using flour or cornstarch

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: divided for the stir-fry and potatoes

ingredients.name: horseradish paste
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste, can be made from fresh horseradish or prepared horseradish sauce

instructions: Boil potatoes in boiling water with a pinch of salt until tender, about 10-12 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Pat dry with paper towels.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Add diced potatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes until they start to brown slightly.
Add remaining olive oil and horseradish paste. Stir-fry for another minute until the horseradish aroma starts to diffuse into the potatoes.
Season with a pinch of baking soda, which will enhance the potato's natural sweetness and give it a slight bite. Cook for about 2 minutes more.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh chives.
